results.rationale: Consistency: the single centered charger is moved left and reduced, the labels become darker, and a separate duplicate two-port panel is added on the right, substantially changing the composition. The white background and general charger styling remain. Instruction: the upper rectangular port remains distinctly wider and taller than the lower port; the added panel also has unequal ports. A correct edit would shrink the original upper interface to the lower interface size. The requested size match is absent. Quality: structure, lighting, clean surface textures and legible QC/18W and PD/20W labels are satisfactory; the two-panel product illustration has no noticeable rendering artifacts.

Consistency: both clocks retain pale faces, white rims, black Arabic numerals and a light wall, but the hands on both faces change direction, and the right clock and overall framing are enlarged and repositioned. These are multiple non-requested changes beyond resizing the small clock. Instruction: the formerly smaller left clock now has the same apparent diameter as the right clock, fulfilling the requested size match. Quality: both circular clock structures, numeral sequences, hands, shadows and smooth wall textures are coherent and clean, with no noticeable visual artifacts.
